subject: data/editorial/private-eurostat-external-gate-inventory-v2.2.json

review_amendment.finding: The article-attribution gate required citation_text to be non-empty, but the identity SELECT did not project a.citation_text.
review_amendment.change: Added a.citation_text to the SELECT and required_columns list before approval.

verified.evidence: rights_json contains only AssetRights fields. evidence_conflict and chart_reuse_prohibited are required exclusively below metadata_json.$.rights_evidence.
The contract separates $.source from $.rights_evidence and specifies each persisted rights-evidence assertion with an exact JSON path.

attribution_terms is captured without a non-empty requirement. The executable projection now includes citation_text, attribution_name, attribution_url, and the policy fields needed by the article-attribution gate.
The observed HTTPS embed_origin must equal origin(embed_url) and match one of the two explicitly reviewed Cite Supply production origins.
Identity lookup may resolve safe or restricted rows for diagnosis, but the release rights contract requires rights_status=safe and blocks restricted rows.
Both draft hashes, both rendered-preview hashes, and the shared analysis-results hash match the current files.
The proposed route is non-indexable, no-store, token-bound, five-minute, single-use, replay-denying, and absent from sitemap/navigation. Implementation and browser QA remain intentionally not run.
The response SHA-256 is defined over exact decoded response-body bytes before parsing or re-serialisation, with content type, decoded byte length, and retrieval time recorded.

non_blocking_observations: The identity query is read-only, parameterized by article asset slug, and returns the asset/source fields required for identity, rights, attribution, and origin checks.
No production D1 query, Eurostat HTTP request, source-policy fetch, private preview, browser QA, asset mutation, rights mutation, commit, or deployment was performed in this review.
Approval authorizes only the read-only production and external-source gates in Step 32; it does not approve either article for release.

next_step.task: Execute the approved read-only production-D1 identity and rights gates plus official Eurostat dataset-freshness and source-policy HTTPS gates. Record reproducible evidence and make no production writes.
